Messages.Author: Michael Beer
Messages.Body:
Form of Mist:
New card text:
"Superior: Strike: Combat Ends. If this vampire is the acting vampire,
this
vampire gets +1 stealth (and this card counts as an action modifier)
and the
action continues as if unblocked."

Situation:

Minion A bleeds
Minion B wakes and blocks
Minion A + B enter combat, Minion A strikes superior Form of Mist
Minion B (awake) gains 1 intercept and attempts to block again
Minion A + B enter combat again

Is it legal for Minion A to play FoM in the superior Version again to
gain the S:CE, but without the "continue action" effect?

We're not sure about it, and ruled that it wasn't legal. Consequently,
Minion A entered torpor an instant later (Minion B was some REALLY angry
Brujah who currently lacked an IG).

Michael Beer
